anchor.problem: Choose which fixed local detailed-route repair alternatives to exactly validate before a deadline while retaining complete rule/connectivity outcomes.
anchor.downstream_need: Reduce time to complete connected engine-DRC-clean route while preserving post-route timing at fixed design/technology conditions.
anchor.causal_mechanism: Feed context-complete cross-candidate exact-obligation sharing and its discovery cost into bounded subset selection, rather than independently scoring immediate repair value and isolated checking cost.
mechanism_invariants: Same canonical routed checkpoint and <=16 fixed same-net wire/via repair candidates
Complete predicate-context and negative-range dependencies; unsupported rules full fallback or UNKNOWN
Exact acceptance owned by pinned checker and connectivity oracle; predictor schedules only
Equal information/candidate/cache/fallback and full costs against strong conventional selection
Primary gain must survive full downstream closure/timing checks; cache hits alone insufficient
forbidden_pivots: Replacing subset-selection contribution with generic caching or a hash log
Claiming agent count or unified-model labels as novelty
Moving to placement/sizing or pure hotspot prediction under this ID
Replacing physical closure need with toy reward/cache-hit optimization

combination_drift.rationale: Same fixed sibling pool, exact-context sharing and charged discovery influence subset choice. Acquisition/estimator contract specifies the existing anchor rather than replacing it.

demand_drift.rationale: Same route-closure engineer and complete checked-route/timing endpoint; payload savings are diagnostics only.
